CheckTitle: Bedrock Agent idle session TTL is not excessive
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Description: Check that Amazon Bedrock Agents do not have an excessive idle session TTL. A shorter TTL reduces the window for session and conversation-context reuse.

Code.NativeIaC:
Resources:
  BedrockAgent:
    Type: AWS::Bedrock::Agent
    Properties:
      IdleSessionTTLInSeconds: 3600
Code.Other: In the AWS Console, navigate to Amazon Bedrock > Agents, select the agent, edit its configuration and reduce the Idle session TTL to 3600 seconds or less.

Recommendation.Text: Configure Bedrock Agents with an idle session TTL of 3600 seconds (1 hour) or less, using the audit configuration key max_bedrock_agent_idle_session_ttl_seconds to customize the threshold.

Risk: An excessive idle session TTL widens the session and conversation-context reuse window, increasing the risk of unintended data retention, session hijacking, or stale context being used by subsequent invocations.
